goldens.comment: OAuth state uses pipeline.signature (static) instead of a per-request random value

goldens.comment: The code attempts to access integration.metadata[sender][login] without checking for the existence of the sender key. This causes a KeyError for integrations where the sender metadata was not set during creation
goldens.reasoning: C2 identifies the same KeyError when the sender key is missing from metadata.

candidates: OAuthLoginView uses pipeline.signature as the OAuth state, but pipeline.signature is a deterministic MD5 of pipeline view class names, making the state guessable and not session-specific, which breaks OAuth CSRF/replay protection

integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] at line 503 will raise a KeyError for any Integration whose metadata lacks a sender key, since the sender field is only conditionally added during build_integration

get_user_info(payload["access_token"]) at line 434 is called without exception handling, and since the function calls resp.raise_for_status() which raises HTTPError on non-2xx responses, it causes an unhandled 500 error instead of the graceful error page used by other failure modes
